```{r data_loading, include=FALSE}
# Load the data
df <- read.csv("../data/bbc_news_articles.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Handle date parsing more robustly
tryCatch({
  df$published <- parse_date_time(df$published, 
                                  orders = c("ymd_HMS", "ymd_HM", "ymd", "dmy_HMS", "dmy_HM", "dmy"),
                                  quiet = TRUE)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Warning: Could not parse dates properly. Using string version instead.\n")
  df$published <- as.character(df$published)
})

# Filter for Trump articles
df_trump <- df %>%
  filter(grepl("\\bTrump\\b", content, ignore.case = TRUE))

# Add month column
if(is.character(df_trump$published)) {
  df_trump$month <- substr(df_trump$published, 1, 7)
} else {
  df_trump$month <- floor_date(df_trump$published, "month")
}

# Calculate sentiment
df_trump$content <- ifelse(is.na(df_trump$content), "", df_trump$content)
tryCatch({
  if(require(vader, quietly = TRUE)) {
    df_trump$sentiment <- vader_df(df_trump$content)$compound
  } else {
    raw_sentiment <- get_sentiment(df_trump$content, method = "syuzhet")
    df_trump$sentiment <- tanh(raw_sentiment / max(abs(raw_sentiment), na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  raw_sentiment <- get_sentiment(df_trump$content, method = "bing")
  df_trump$sentiment <- raw_sentiment / max(abs(raw_sentiment), na.rm = TRUE)
})
df_trump$sentiment <- pmax(-1, pmin(1, df_trump$sentiment))
```

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Global Sentiment on Trump-Related Articles {data-height=600}
```{r choropleth_map}
# Function to find country mentions
find_countries_in_text <- function(text) {
  all_countries <- unique(countrycode::codelist$country.name.en)
  if(is.na(text)) return(character(0))
  mentioned <- all_countries[sapply(all_countries, function(country) {
    grepl(paste0("\\b", country, "\\b"), text, ignore.case = TRUE)
  })]
  mentioned
}

if(nrow(df_trump) > 0) {
  country_sentiments <- list()
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(df_trump))) {
    txt <- df_trump$content[i]
    if(nzchar(txt)) {
      sent <- df_trump$sentiment[i]
      ctrs <- find_countries_in_text(txt)
      for(c in ctrs) {
        country_sentiments[[c]] <- c(country_sentiments[[c]], sent)
      }
    }
  }
  sent_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(country_sentiments), function(country) {
    iso <- countrycode::countrycode(country, "country.name", "iso3c")
    data.frame(country=country,
               iso3=iso,
               avg_sentiment=mean(country_sentiments[[country]], na.rm=TRUE),
               article_count=length(country_sentiments[[country]]),
               stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }))

  if(nrow(sent_data) >= 3) {
    plot_ly(sent_data, type="choropleth",
            locations=~iso3, z=~avg_sentiment,
            text=~paste(country, "<br>Sentiment:", round(avg_sentiment,3),
                        "<br>Articles:", article_count),
            colorscale=list(c(0,"red"),c(0.5,"white"),c(1,"green")),
            zmin=-1,zmax=1) %>%
      colorbar(title="Sentiment Score") %>%
      layout(title="Average Sentiment on Trump-Related Articles by Country Mentions",
             geo=list(showframe=FALSE, showcoastlines=TRUE,
                      projection=list(type="natural earth")))
  } else {
    plot.new(); text(0.5,0.5,"Not enough country mentions to create world map\n(Need at least 3 countries)")
  }
} else {
  plot.new(); text(0.5,0.5,"No content data available for country sentiment analysis")
}
```

### Word Clouds of Most Extreme Articles {data-height=400}
```{r wordclouds, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
if(nrow(df_trump)>=10) {
  neg10 <- df_trump %>% arrange(sentiment) %>% head(10)
  pos10 <- df_trump %>% arrange(desc(sentiment)) %>% head(10)
  neg_text <- paste(neg10$content, collapse=" ")
  pos_text <- paste(pos10$content, collapse=" ")
  custom_sw <- c(stopwords("english"), "trump","said","would","also","one","new","us",
                 "mr","ms","will","people","can","could","may","just","say","says",
                 "going","go","went","bbc","year","years","time","get","got","now",
                 "today","week","month","day","way","like","make","made","use","used",
                 "even","since","last","first","two","three","many","much","well","still",
                 "back","see","saw","really","good","bad","need","take","know","think","come","came")

  par(mfrow=c(1,2), mar=c(1,1,3,1))
  tryCatch({
    neg_c <- Corpus(VectorSource(neg_text)) %>%
      tm_map(content_transformer(tolower)) %>%
      tm_map(removePunctuation) %>%
      tm_map(removeNumbers) %>%
      tm_map(removeWords, custom_sw) %>%
      tm_map(stripWhitespace)
    neg_tdm <- TermDocumentMatrix(neg_c)
    neg_freqs <- rowSums(as.matrix(neg_tdm))
    if(length(neg_freqs)>10) {
      wordcloud(names(neg_freqs), neg_freqs, max.words=100, random.order=FALSE,
                colors=brewer.pal(8,"Dark2"), scale=c(3,0.3))
      title("Word Cloud of 10 Most Negative Articles", line=1)
    }

    pos_c <- Corpus(VectorSource(pos_text)) %>%
      tm_map(content_transformer(tolower)) %>%
      tm_map(removePunctuation) %>%
      tm_map(removeNumbers) %>%
      tm_map(removeWords, custom_sw) %>%
      tm_map(stripWhitespace)
    pos_tdm <- TermDocumentMatrix(pos_c)
    pos_freqs <- rowSums(as.matrix(pos_tdm))
    if(length(pos_freqs)>10) {
      wordcloud(names(pos_freqs), pos_freqs, max.words=100, random.order=FALSE,
                colors=brewer.pal(8,"Set2"), scale=c(3,0.3))
      title("Word Cloud of 10 Most Positive Articles", line=1)
    }
  }, error=function(e){
    plot.new(); text(0.5,0.5,"Error creating wordclouds")
  })
} else {
  plot.new(); text(0.5,0.5,"Not enough articles for wordcloud analysis")
}
```

### Sentiment Distribution for Trump Articles {data-height=300}
```{r sentiment_distribution}
if(nrow(df_trump)>0) {
  hist_data <- hist(df_trump$sentiment, breaks=20, plot=FALSE)
  max_count <- max(hist_data$counts)
  ann <- data.frame(x=0.05, y=max_count*0.8, label="Neutral\nThreshold")
  p <- ggplot(df_trump, aes(x=sentiment)) +
    geom_histogram(bins=20, fill="lightblue", color="black", alpha=0.7) +
    geom_density(aes(y=after_stat(density)*nrow(df_trump)*0.1),
                 alpha=0.3, fill="blue") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x="VADER Compound Score", y="Count",
         title="Distribution of VADER Compound Scores for Trump Articles") +
    geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="black") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1,1)) +
    geom_text(data=ann, aes(x=x, y=y, label=label), inherit.aes=FALSE, size=3, hjust=0)
  ggplotly(p)
} else {
  plot.new(); text(0.5,0.5,"No data available")
}
```

### Topic Modeling & Sentiment Analysis {data-height=400}
```{r topic_modeling, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if(nrow(df_trump) >= 10) {
  clean_content <- df_trump$content %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_remove_all("[^a-zA-Z\\s]") %>%
    str_squish()
  corpus <- Corpus(VectorSource(clean_content)) %>%
    tm_map(removeWords, stopwords("english")) %>%
    tm_map(stripWhitespace)
  dtm <- DocumentTermMatrix(corpus, control=list(bounds=list(global=c(2,Inf))))
  dtm <- removeSparseTerms(dtm, 0.95)
  rowTotals <- rowSums(as.matrix(dtm))
  dtm <- dtm[rowTotals>0,]
  df_filt <- df_trump[rowTotals>0,]

  if(nrow(dtm)>=6 && ncol(dtm)>=10) {
    set.seed(42)
    lda_model <- LDA(dtm, k=6, method="Gibbs",
                     control=list(seed=42, iter=10, verbose=FALSE))
    topics <- topics(lda_model)
    df_filt$dominant_topic <- topics
    terms_mat <- terms(lda_model, 8)
    topic_labels <- apply(terms_mat, 2, function(x) paste(x[1:4], collapse=", "))
    topic_sentiment <- df_filt %>%
      group_by(dominant_topic) %>%
      summarise(avg_sentiment=mean(sentiment,na.rm=TRUE),
                count=n()) %>%
      mutate(topic_keywords=topic_labels[dominant_topic]) %>%
      arrange(avg_sentiment)

    p <- ggplot(topic_sentiment, aes(x=avg_sentiment,
                                     y=reorder(topic_keywords,avg_sentiment))) +
      geom_col(fill="skyblue",color="black") +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(y="Topic Keywords", x="Average VADER Compound Sentiment",
           title="Avg Sentiment by LDA Topic for Trump Articles") +
      geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
      scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1,1))
    ggplotly(p)
  } else {
    plot.new(); text(0.5,0.5,"Insufficient data for topic modeling")
  }
} else {
  plot.new(); text(0.5,0.5,"Insufficient data for topic modeling")
}
```

### Sentiment by Section for Trump Articles {data-height=300}
```{r section_sentiment}
if("section" %in% names(df_trump) && length(unique(df_trump$section))>1) {
  sec_counts <- df_trump %>% group_by(section) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% filter(n>=3)
  df_sec <- df_trump %>% filter(section %in% sec_counts$section)
  if(nrow(df_sec)>0) {
    p <- ggplot(df_sec, aes(x=section, y=sentiment)) +
      geom_boxplot(fill="lightblue", alpha=0.7) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(x="Section", y="VADER Compound Score",
           title="Sentiment by Section for Trump-Related Articles") +
      theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="red") +
      scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-1,1))
    ggplotly(p)
  } else {
    plot.new(); text(0.5,0.5,"Not enough sections with sufficient articles")
  }
} else {
  plot.new(); text(0.5,0.5,"Section data not available")
}
```

### Top Extreme Headlines {data-height=200}
```{r headlines}
if(nrow(df_trump)>=10 && "headline" %in% names(df_trump)) {
  neg5 <- df_trump %>% arrange(sentiment) %>% head(5) %>%
    select(headline, sentiment) %>%
    mutate(sentiment=round(sentiment,3), type="Negative") %>% arrange(sentiment)
  pos5 <- df_trump %>% arrange(desc(sentiment)) %>% head(5) %>%
    select(headline, sentiment) %>%
    mutate(sentiment=round(sentiment,3), type="Positive") %>% arrange(desc(sentiment))
  extreme <- bind_rows(neg5 %>% select(type, headline, sentiment),
                       pos5 %>% select(type, headline, sentiment))
  DT::datatable(extreme, options=list(pageLength=10, scrollX=TRUE, scrollY="300px", dom='t',
                                      columnDefs=list(list(width='80px',targets=0),
                                                      list(width='60px',targets=2),
                                                      list(width='400px',targets=1))),
                rownames=FALSE,
                colnames=c("Type","Headline","Sentiment"), caption="Top 5 Most Negative and Positive Headlines") %>%
    DT::formatStyle("sentiment",
                    backgroundColor=DT::styleInterval(c(-0.1,0.1), c("#ffcccc","#ffffcc","#ccffcc"))) %>%
    DT::formatStyle("type",
                    backgroundColor=DT::styleEqual(c("Negative","Positive"), c("#ffe6e6","#e6ffe6")))
} else {
  cat("<div style='text-align: center; padding: 50px;'>")
  cat("<p style='font-size: 16px; color: #666;'>Insufficient data for headline analysis</p>")
  cat("</div>")
}
```
